thread:
Sam (Finance): Quick planning thread for the 10% A/B pricing experiment tomorrow. We need a clear refunds/reversal plan if customers dispute new line items.
Linh (Accounting): Agree. We should pre-create reversal invoices with GL mapping so accounting can net them quickly. What's our expected refund flow?
Sam (Finance): Plan A: no automatic refunds — instead create memo reversal and credit note when customer requests. Plan B (contingency): auto-apply pro-rata credit if invoice delta > $500 for first billing cycle. Need sign-off.
Omar (Billing Eng): Billing engine can emit credit_notes for matched invoice ids. I can add a pipeline to auto-create credits when `delta_amount > 500 AND experiment_flag = true`. Example config: ```{ "experiment_id": "A_B_10pct_2027", "auto_credit_threshold": 500, "credit_reason": "pricing_experiment_adjustment" }```
Talia (Prod Ops): Can we limit auto-credits to customers not on custom contracts? Last time a custom billing rule accidentally credited an enterprise with a non-standard ledger code.
Sam (Finance): Good call. Add filter `custom_billing = false` and `rate_lock = false`.
Linh (Accounting): GL mapping note: credits should post to GL 4201 (Billing Adjustments) and not revenue account 4000. Also tag with `experiment_tag` so we can run reconciliation.
ledger-bot: automated note 1793345678: creating tag schema `experiment_tag:A_B_10pct_2027` and ledger rule template `credit_posting:4201`.
Ivy (Compliance): Check VAT implications for credits on EU customers. Credits may affect tax reporting; we should include tax_code on credit notes.
Omar (Billing Eng): We'll include `tax_rate` and `tax_code` when generating credits. Staging test payload: ```{ "invoice_id": "stg-998", "original_amount": 1200.00, "experiment_amount": 1500.00, "delta": 300.00, "auto_credit": false }```
Sam (Finance): For the experiment, cohort split 90/10 (control/experiment) not 50/50. Keep it small. Cohort selection SQL (snapshot): ```SELECT id FROM customers WHERE monthly_spend >= 2000 AND months_active >= 6 AND custom_billing = false AND rate_lock = false ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 100```
Talia (Prod Ops): Ops checklist before 08:00 UTC launch: 1) snapshot exported and stored, 2) staging invoices showing experiment line present, 3) credit automation toggle feature-tested, 4) accounting sample GL entries validated.
Linh (Accounting): I'll validate GL post on staging today at 18:00 PT. Please share sample invoice ids.
Omar (Billing Eng): Pushed a PR for the crediting lambda, tests included. Will run end-to-end on staging tomorrow 05:30 UTC.
Sam (Finance): Who owns customer comms if we need to issue credits? Recommend CS owns outreach and Finance signs off on credit amounts.
Talia (Prod Ops): CS will be on standby. Nora was on last experiment; tagging her separately.
Ivy (Compliance): Also ensure we don't label it as a "discount" in customer-facing copy; use "temporary pricing test" and include opt-out instructions.
Sam (Finance): Approvals needed: Accounting (Linh) for GL mapping and Omar for billing automation. Reply with :white_check_mark: if approved.
Linh (Accounting): :white_check_mark: GL mapping approved.
Omar (Billing Eng): :white_check_mark: automation approved, will monitor for false positives.
ledger-bot: automated note 1793346500: staging credit run completed, 2 simulated credits created, GL 4201 postings OK.
Sam (Finance): Great. Final note: postmortem and reconciliation run at 72h and 30 days. I'll create a spreadsheet with `experiment_tag` filters for Revenue Ops. Thanks everyone.
